scope.JN1_reason: Engineering prerequisite admitted only within unchanged monitored v5 scope: both range stops are independently explained lower-cavity/overhang drop-height mismatches, not solver/interface faults or general multi-support refusal. They preserve failed actions and exact stop semantics. This permits small real-selector integration under the same conservative stop boundary; it does not establish full-order reliability or policy benefit. Two of eight orders (both fixed-order) hit the boundary and those pairs are excluded from valid strategy comparison.
scope_conditions: No algorithm, candidate, data or tolerance adjustment authorized.
Continue to classify POSE_HEIGHT_MISMATCH as UNASSESSABLE and stop the selected order; no candidate replacement.
Use same public boundary for all methods; retain range-stop denominators and report affected pairs.
Any broader cavity-handling algorithm change requires separate version and acceptance; no present claim of full geometric coverage.
